summary: Full retest after medieval/RPG redesign. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (root, projects+rarity, single project, 404, experiences, achievements, contact create+list+invalid+empty). Frontend e2e: Hero (kicker, title, scroll cue, 3D bonfire canvas), Nav (4 links: about/experience/projects/connect), About (character-sheet, portrait, skills, socials, resume, 6 achievement medallions from /api/achievements), Experience (trail-map SVG with 4 clickable nodes + 4 experience-card-{id}), Projects (4 quest cards with link+demo buttons), Contact (invalid email -> contact-error 'Please enter a valid email.', valid submit -> contact-success). No page errors. Previous iteration_1 invalid-email bug is fixed (email field now type='text' with JS regex validation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses ContactCreate(EmailStr) + Mongo projections {_id: 0} consistently — no ObjectId leakage.
Static seed lists (PROJECTS/EXPERIENCES/ACHIEVEMENTS) are fine for portfolio scope; would need DB-backed CRUD if admin editing is added later.
Contact.jsx now correctly validates email client-side before POST and surfaces contact-error testid (regression-safe).
Consider adding spam protection / rate limiting on POST /api/contact for production.
Three.js BonfireScene canvas is mounted in Hero (pointer-events-none wrapper), allowing scroll-cue clicks to pass through — verified.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_user/TEST_Wanderer contact messages via POST /api/contact during pytest + browser test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, /projects(+rarity), /projects/{id}, 404, /experiences, /achievements, /contact (create/list/invalid email/empty).
